dct_description_sm:
This data set proposes the location of outdoor Wi-Fi coverage areas in Montreal and inside public buildings in the City of Montreal.

The [dynamic mapping] (https://montreal.ca/programmes/mtlwifi) is also available for a quick geographic search of sites.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
